name: Loop & Thread
tagline: Wool socks knit in Asheville, in batches of two hundred.
intro: We run four old knitting machines in a converted bakery. Every pair is merino from one farm in Virginia, and every batch sells out, so sign up for the next drop.

products.name: Ember crew
products.desc: Our everyday crew sock. Cushioned sole, reinforced heel and toe, and a cuff that stays up.

products.name: Moss hiker
products.desc: Thicker merino for boots and cold mornings. Fits a half size bigger, so size down if you're between.

products.name: Shop tee
products.desc: A heavyweight tee with our little loop on the chest. Printed by Blue Ridge Print Co.

products.name: Market tote
products.desc: Fits a week of groceries or four dozen pairs of socks.

products.name: Machine-room mug
products.desc: The mug we drink coffee from while the machines run. Dishwasher safe.

products.name: Six-panel cap
products.desc: Unstructured cotton cap with an embroidered loop.

facts.title: Shipping
facts.text: Ships in 2 to 4 days from Asheville. Free over $60 in the US.

facts.title: Returns
facts.text: Unworn items within 30 days. Email us and we'll send a label.

facts.title: Made by
facts.text: Four people and four machines. Say hi if you're ever in town.

faq.a: True to shoe size, except the Moss hiker, which runs a little big.
Every batch is different. Join the drop list and you'll hear first.

faq.q: Can I order for a team or a shop?
faq.a: Yes. Email us with how many and when you need them.
